newsitem.title: JAPAN: Tokyo rubber futures end higher on weaker yen.
newsitem.headline: Tokyo rubber futures end higher on weaker yen.

text.p: Tokyo rubber futures ended higher across the board on Thursday, buoyed by the dollar's stronger tendency against the yen, traders said.
Prices ranged from 1.4 yen to 2.2 yen per kg firmer. Benchmark September was up 2.1 yen at 146.1 yen.
Activity remained lacklustre. Rubber prices opened narrowly mixed, and edged up later on the yen's further dip against the dollar, traders said.
"Private investors were still wary of taking fresh positions amid uncertainty over near-term trends in the currency market," one trader said.
